entry.title: feat(acquaintance): full hands via 7-quantized load ladder + grammar …
entry.content:
feat(acquaintance): full hands via 7-quantized load ladder + grammar leak fixes (#500)

Problem 1 — degenerate short hands: hand size was
min(daily_remaining, 7) against the 3/6/9/15/21/30 ladder,
producing 1-6 card tail hands (user-visible "hand of 2").

- DailyLoad ladder quantized to full hands: 7/14/21/28/35/42
  (1-6 hands/day); the default variant moves Medium -> Light
  (=14 cards, 2 hands) — variant order and persistence untouched.
- Hand is always min(7, pool); the daily remainder gates only
  the OPENING of a hand, never its size.
- Cluster selection: each hand kanji pulls up to 3 new pool
  words containing its glyph into the same hand (displacing the
  lowest-priority non-cluster words; kanji, grammar and cluster
  words are never displaced, hand size unchanged).
- "Already know" replacement tops up an under-clustered hand
  kanji first, then falls back to the pool top.

Problem 2 — new cards leaking from the New status into SRS
bypassing acquaintance (visible as phantom studied-today entries
and budget drain):

- view mutations only use non-new grammar rules (known_grammars
  filtered by is_new);
- dual rating never rates a new card and never double-rates the
  card just answered (a quiz on the grammar card itself used to
  advance it twice per answer);
- dead create-and-rate branch removed: rule cards are only
  created explicitly.

Companion migration cleanup:

- startup MigrateKanjiCompanionsUseCase removed (phantom new-card
  counter jumps on every launch); the REMOVED_POPULAR_WORDS guard
  moved into create_companion_vocab_cards, covering all companion
  pipelines; audit script comment + manual-sync note updated.

Test infrastructure:

- on_quiz_toggle tests wrapped in Owner::new().with() like their
  siblings — signal/Callback registration in the global reactive
  runtime raced across parallel test threads (load flake).

Docs: landing fsrs/lesson (EN+RU) de-numberized per tone rules,
acquaintance-mode.md spec, glossary, ADR-002/043 superseding
notes. BDD daily-limit scenario text extended past the new
Minimal=7 threshold (verified natively, 13 recognized words).

entry.title: fix(acquaintance): reset finishing window on lesson reload (review fo…
entry.content:
fix(acquaintance): reset finishing window on lesson reload (review follow-up to #498) (#499)

* fix(acquaintance): reset finishing window on lesson reload (review follow-up)

The new hand_finishing flag was never cleared: AcquaintanceState is
created once per LessonContent mount and a lesson reload re-initializes
the hand through the same state, so a second hand in a session inherited
the finished flag — its presentation/training buttons and keyboard
handlers stayed gated forever and the lesson dead-ended on the first
slide.

The re-initialization now lives in AcquaintanceState::start_new_hand
(single owner, resets every stream field including hand_finishing) and
content.rs uses it. Covered by a host test on the reset and a wasm test
driving hand #1 to completion, then reloading a hand #2 into the same
mounted state and asserting the action bar and its buttons recover.

Review Low items:
- audit trims the content level like build.rs does (symmetric contract);
- audit also checks the reverse direction: every Duolingo meta entry
  must have a content file (stale records cannot survive regeneration);
- the presentation action bar container is gated as a whole during the
  finishing window (no empty striped placeholder under the slide).

* test(acquaintance): seed skipped_ids in start_new_hand reset fixture (review nit)

entry.title: fix: acquaintance UX batch + Duolingo JLPT distribution + dictionary …
entry.content:
fix: acquaintance UX batch + Duolingo JLPT distribution + dictionary casing (#498)

* fix(sets): take Duolingo JLPT levels from content files, not titles

The build.rs title heuristic took the first 'Section'/'Модуль' token from
the EN+RU title blob. RU-series English titles carry both tokens
('Module 5 Section 16'), so the parser read the sub-unit number: 55 sets
were silently dropped (section > 6) and 66 tagged with their unit's level
instead of their module's (e.g. 'Модуль 5 Раздел 1' tagged N5).

Duolingo levels now come verbatim from each content file's own 'level'
field (corpus ground truth: Section/Модуль 1-3 -> N5, 4 -> N4, 5-6 -> N3;
451 sets, 100% self-consistent). Empty/invalid levels skip with a
cargo:warning, symmetric to the previous behavior.

The audit test now guards completeness (every content file present in
meta) and fidelity (meta level == content level, one of N5/N4/N3).
The deprecated remap script loses its Duolingo branch (Spy-only now):
its old 3-4->N4 mapping contradicted the corpus and would fight the
canonical source.

* fix(acquaintance): audio button placement, CDN-file autoplay, tooltip opacity, completion freeze

Four user-reported acquaintance-mode bugs:

- Play button jumped the hand progress strip: it lived in the lesson
  header next to HandProgressStrip, so its show/hide resized the strip
  between cards. Moved to the tags row right edge (ml-auto) — the same
  AudioButtons component and placement as the regular lesson card
  header; the header strip now renders only the progress strip.
- Autoplay sounded like TTS instead of the audio file: presentation and
  training Forward autoplay used speak_word_immediate, which plays TTS
  whenever the CDN blob cache is cold (always true for new words).
  Both now use speak_word — CDN pitch-audio file first, TTS only as a
  fallback, identical to the regular lesson. The now-unused
  speak_word_immediate is removed. Trade-off: the first autoplay of a
  word may wait for the CDN prefetch round-trip (same as the regular
  lesson); repeats are cached.
- Kanji tooltip on the answered training side was semi-transparent:
  the dimmed question wrapper used a raw opacity-60, which cascades
  into every DOM descendant including .kanji-popup. Replaced with the
  semantic .front-dimmed class whose :has(.kanji-popup) rule lifts the
  dim while the tooltip is open. Covered by a wasm test that injects
  the real stylesheet and asserts computed wrapper opacity 0.6 -> 1
  -> 0.6 across tooltip open/close.
- "Acquaintance complete" appeared abruptly over an extra question:
  the final answer reset showing_answer before the async hand
  completion, so the same card re-asked as a phantom question until
  the Completed card snapped in. The new hand_finishing state flag is
  set synchronously by complete_hand: the answered card stays frozen
  (no phantom question), rating/reveal/know/next buttons and their
  keyboard handlers are gated, and the completion card enters with
  the anima-page-fade animation.

e2e: answerTrainingRating recognizes the finishing window (answer
visible, rating buttons hidden) and waits for the final screen instead
of re-clicking the frozen card.

entry.title: fix(e2e): uiLogin waits for the terminal route, not a transient form …
entry.content:
fix(e2e): uiLogin waits for the terminal route, not a transient form unmount

The race shortcut (URL match OR login form detached) returned while auth
was still in flight: the form unmounts transiently on submit, callers
then clicked onboarding step buttons on what was still the login screen,
and two onboarding-lesson scenarios burned their whole 180s budgets
through retries (the 42-minute job, run 33862838464). The terminal URL
(/home or /onboarding) is the primary wait again; the root-route case
(full-corpus restore, #492) is a fallback that additionally requires
explicit content markers — no login form AND home/wizard mounted — so an
early return is no longer possible.

fix(e2e): wait for the terminal navigation before asserting the rkyv path

uiLogin's new race returns as soon as the login form unmounts, which
can precede the dictionary bootstrap entirely — the overlay-detached
wait then passed in a gap before the overlay ever mounted, and the
rkyv assertion ran against zero requests (run 33841099695, both
attempts). The step now waits for the terminal navigation
(/onboarding for a fresh user, /home for a restored one) first, then
for the overlay to run its course.

entry.title: 🔧 fix(ci): pin ANDROID_AVD_HOME — avdmanager and emulator disagree on it
entry.content:
🔧 fix(ci): pin ANDROID_AVD_HOME — avdmanager and emulator disagree on it

Reproduced locally with the same toolchain: with XDG_CONFIG_HOME set,
cmdline-tools create the AVD under ~/.config/.android/avd while the
emulator binary only searches $ANDROID_AVD_HOME, $ANDROID_SDK_HOME/avd
and $HOME/.android/avd — 'create avd' exits 0 as a silent no-op the
emulator can never see ('Unknown AVD name'). Pin the AVD home explicitly
and hard-fail if smoke.ini is not on disk after creation.

entry.title: 🔧 fix(ci): launch the smoke emulator by absolute SDK path
entry.content:
🔧 fix(ci): launch the smoke emulator by absolute SDK path

setup-android@v4 installs the emulator package but does not add its
directory to PATH (adb is there, emulator is not) — every launch died
with 'nohup: failed to run command emulator'. Resolve it from
ANDROID_SDK_ROOT and fail loudly if the binary is missing.

entry.title: 🔧 chore(ci): harden emulator bootstrap + bounded smoke waits
entry.content:
🔧 chore(ci): harden emulator bootstrap + bounded smoke waits

Run 3 showed the failure mode: the emulator process died silently after
launch and `adb wait-for-device` hung forever (no device ever attached).
- emulator.log tail goes into the job log 15s after launch (early crash
  visibility) and into every smoke failure dump
- KVM verify now checks writability (chmod a+rw fallback), emulator runs
  with -accel on to die loudly instead of software-emulation crawl
- script: bounded device-attachment wait replaces the unbounded
  wait-for-device; boot timeout unchanged (300s)

entry.title: ⚡ fix(ci): boot the smoke emulator in parallel with the build
entry.content:
⚡ fix(ci): boot the smoke emulator in parallel with the build

Emulator boot takes minutes and does not compete for CPU meaningfully —
starting it right after the SDK setup hides the whole boot wait behind
the toolchain/APK build instead of paying it sequentially at the end.
The smoke script already polls sys.boot_completed, so correctness is
unchanged.

entry.title: docs(e2e): trunk serve mutates dist/ — rebuild before static serving
entry.content:
docs(e2e): trunk serve mutates dist/ — rebuild before static serving

trunk serve rewrites dist/index.html on disk with its live-reload
bridge; trunk build does not. A dist that was ever served from is
poisoned for static serving (npx serve dist): the bridge force-reloads
the page on any WS reconnect, aborting WASM loads and restarting long
restores — the exact noise that masked itself as an app bug during the
N1-stress investigation (#492). Documented in origa_ui/AGENTS.md
(Development), verified: a fresh trunk build --release ships no bridge.

Also lands the pending local docs edits (browserslist note in the root
and origa_ui AGENTS.md) and the diag-n1-sentinel.ts hardening from the
investigation (device-1 listeners, full error texts) — the issue's
repro kit.
